messages:
Ana: Heads up — Nimbus Labs reached out about co-hosting a quantized 13B model as a downloadable SKU on AWS Marketplace plus an SI-managed hosted offering. They want a joint announcement and redistribution terms. Key asks: downloadable weights license, redistribution to SI partners, KMS usage for private bundles, and co-branded launch window. cc @Mike @Lucy @Sam :eyes:

Mike (Legal): Thanks Ana. Quick flags: (1) license type — do they want open weights under permissive license or commercial/limited redistribution? (2) export control / EAR risk assessment, especially for quantized weights. (3) indemnity & liability caps for third-party SI resellers. Can they share a proposed contract or redlines?

Ana: They sent a short deck and a sample addendum. Uploading in 1min. Main ask from Nimbus: allow redistribution to certified SIs and AWS Marketplace downloadable listing.

legal-bot: New file uploaded: Nimbus_SKU_Addendum_v1.pdf — legal review requested by @Mike :white_check_mark:

Mike (Legal): Skimming addendum — their clause suggests: "reseller redistribution allowed for certified partners; credit + attribution required; no further sub-licensing." We need explicit export-control clause and a clause for model provenance/weights signing. Also request a sample SLA for hosted SI offering.

Lucy (Solutions): For SI-managed hosted offering: we need a spec for deployment artifacts. Do they expect: (a) downloadable tarball of quantized weights (b) container image for inference (c) S3-hosted model + manifest that points to compatible runtime. Also clarify whether SIs will get host-level access or just an API wrapper.

Raj (Eng): Technical note: Nimbus provides weights in 4-bit and 8-bit formats. Shipping both is fine, but we must define canonical naming and checksums. Large models require signed manifests and an optional attest file. For AWS Marketplace downloadable SKU we prefer: manifest.json, weights/*.bin, runtime/container.sha256. Example manifest snippet:

```json
{
  "model_name": "nimbus-13b-q8",
  "formats": ["q4",("q8")],
  "sha256": "<hash>",
  "quantization_notes": "f32->q4 static range",
  "kms_encrypted": false
}
```

Raj (Eng): Also note: if they want KMS-protected weight bundles for private/on-prem customers, we need a handshake flow + documented KMS envelope keys. That adds ops complexity for SI installs.

Sam (Product): Announcement side — propose dual-path launch: (1) AWS Marketplace downloadable SKU with clear license and instructions, launch date + marketplace listing; (2) Joint SI-hosted offering announced ~2 weeks later after SI integration validation. We should lock embargo dates and asset list (blog, marketplace banner, joint press release). :calendar:

Ana: Agreed. Nimbus wants co-marketing and a joint webinar. They requested a 3-week lead time. We need legal signoff by EOD Friday to make that.

Mike (Legal): Action items: (a) confirm license (we can propose Apache 2.0 + attribution + export control exhibit OR a limited commercial redistribution addendum), (b) draft redistribution addendum allowing certified SI redistribution under specified controls, (c) include indemnity language limited to gross negligence. I'll draft a redline and share by tomorrow morning.

Lucy (Solutions): Ops action items: define packaging spec (manifest + signed weights + optional container), SI onboarding checklist (certification steps, support contact, escalation flow). I'll draft checklist and share by EOD Thursday.

Raj (Eng): I'll prepare a small validation script to verify manifest/sha256 and a sample KMS envelope flow for private bundles. ETA: 3 working days.

Sam (Product): Marketing action items: draft launch timeline + assets list. Need final license text before writing marketplace listing copy.

Ana: OK — proposed decision point: choose license path. If we go permissive (Apache 2.0 + attribution), faster but broader redistribution. If we go limited commercial addendum, need tighter SI certification and reseller controls. Thoughts?

Mike (Legal): My leaning is limited addendum for now (protects us + Nimbus + SIs), but allow a future reclass if Nimbus proves provenance & compliance.

Lucy (Solutions): Limited addendum is fine; ops will add certification gates.

Raj (Eng): Also require signed manifest and verification as a precondition for SI certification.

Ana: Great — I'll schedule a quick sync Fri 10am PT to review Mike's redline and the ops checklist. Nimbus is OK with that window.

Sam (Product): :thumbsup: I'll block time on the calendar and start the asset tracker.

Ana: Thanks team — tracking in partnership board. Will share links to deck & addendum in thread now.
